title: Incidence realization of a mixed join and replacement of local cocone representatives
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, quasicategories, coherent transformations and cocones of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] and the join-slice comparison $J_a\to P_a$ of [lem-coef-join-slice-cocone-comparison]. Let $K$ be a small simplicial set, $I$ a small poset and $(K_i\subseteq K)_{i\in I}$ a monotone family of simplicial subsets. Let $H\subseteq K\star N(I)$ be the mixed subset defined in [lem-coef-directed-cover-mixed-subset-cells]. Define $V_n$ to be the set of pairs $(\sigma,i_0\leq\cdots\leq i_n)$ with $\sigma\in(K_{i_0})_n$. For a monotone map $\theta:[m]\to[n]$, the operator takes this pair to $(\theta^*\sigma,i_{\theta(0)}\leq\cdots\leq i_{\theta(m)})$, using the inclusion $K_{i_0}\subseteq K_{i_{\theta(0)}}$. These sets form a simplicial set $V$. Write $u:V\to K$ and $v:V\to N(I)$ for the two projections, and $v_i:K_i\to V$ for the constant-index map. Let $\mathcal E$ be a quasicategory and $q:H\to\mathcal E$ any simplicial map; put $p=q|_K$ and $c=q|_{N(I)}$.

There is a coherent transformation $a_0:V\times\Delta^1\to\mathcal E$ from $pu$ to $cv$: on $(\sigma,i_0\leq\cdots\leq i_n)$ and a monotone $\epsilon:[n]\to[1]$, apply $q$ to the simplex with initial block $\sigma|_{\epsilon^{-1}(0)}$ and final block $(i_j)_{j\in\epsilon^{-1}(1)}$, retaining the pure block if the other is empty. Its restriction along $v_i\times\mathrm{id}$ is exactly the coherent cocone associated to $q|_{K_i^{\triangleright}}$ by $J_{p|K_i}\to P_{p|K_i}$.

For each $i$, let $\eta_i$ be a prescribed coherent cocone on $p|_{K_i}$ with apex $c(i)$ and choose an equivalence from the preceding associated cocone to $\eta_i$ in the strict fiber of $P_{p|K_i}\to\mathcal E$ over $c(i)$. There exists a coherent transformation $a:V\times\Delta^1\to\mathcal E$ whose endpoints are exactly $pu,cv$ and whose restriction along every $v_i\times\mathrm{id}$ is exactly $\eta_i$. Moreover $a_0$ and $a$ are equivalent as diagrams relative to both endpoints: there is an equivalence edge in the strict fiber of $\operatorname{Fun}(V\times\Delta^1,\mathcal E)\to\operatorname{Fun}(V\times\partial\Delta^1,\mathcal E)$ over the given endpoints, with the chosen local equivalences as restrictions.

For every join cocone $\widetilde\lambda:H^{\triangleright}\to\mathcal E$ on $q$, with apex $C$, let $\lambda$ and $\nu$ be its associated coherent cocones on $p$ and $c$. For any such $a$ and its relative equivalence from $a_0$, there exists a map $t:V\times\Delta^2\to\mathcal E$ with faces $d_2t=a$, $d_0t=(v\times\mathrm{id})^*\nu$ and $d_1t=(u\times\mathrm{id})^*\lambda$. No initiality, colimit, covering, directedness or nonemptiness assumption is imposed.
